evals.name: isolate-sql-dependent-unit-test
evals.prompt: I need an ABAP Unit test for a class method that reads a database table. Show how to keep the test independent of persistent system data and structure it clearly.
evals.expected_output: Recommends an OSQL test environment or suitable test double, describes isolated test setup and cleanup, and follows Arrange-Act-Assert.

evals.name: route-production-code-review
evals.prompt: Review this production ABAP method for Clean ABAP naming and readability. Don't write tests; I only want code-quality findings.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the request is a Clean ABAP review rather than test design and routes to the abap skill without adding test scaffolding.
